Hi Logan — thanks for the sample. We can support a targeted removal of a single conversation/thread from our telemetry and retention indexes, subject to verification steps and legal approval.

High-level plan: 
- We will verify the thread matches the request (you provided audit_sample.json — thank you).
- Security will perform a scoped excision from retention indexes and remove the conversation from searchable telemetry.
- Engineering will run a scrub job and rotate any transient caches.
- We will provide a deletion_confirmation.txt artifact and a reference Jira ticket.

Next steps for you: please reply with the exact thread creation timestamp (UTC) and the account id (or HubSpot record id). If you prefer, authorize the removal by replying to this thread with "authorize THREAD-DEL-772" so our legal team has an explicit record.

Ben — looping you in for any customer communication / billing sensitivity. Marissa — can your team own verification and the deletion window? Aditya, we may need an engineering runbook for the scrub.

Regards,

Hi Logan — I have the verification done and logged under internal ticket SUPP-772. Summary of verification steps completed: 
- Cross-checked thread id and timestamps against retention index snapshot (snapshot id: snap-20270804-UID89).
- Confirmed account id HHL-55921 ownership and that the request includes an explicit authorization string.

Planned deletion window: 2027-08-05 14:00 — 15:00 PDT. What we will do during that window: 
1) Quiesce any active caches for the affected model routes.
2) Run a scoped excision job that removes the conversation payload and associated telemetry entries from retention indexes and the searchable activity store.
3) Rotate ephemeral caches and KV caches used by inference nodes to prevent rehydration of the purged object.
4) Generate an audit artifact (deletion_confirmation.txt) that includes job id, snapshot references, and hashes of removed entries.

Risks & notes: 
- This operation does not alter customer-owned model weights or training corpora.
- If the conversation was included in any long-term aggregated telemetry artifacts, those aggregates will be flagged; full removal from precomputed aggregates is a separate process and will be noted in the artifact if present.
- We may need to preserve a redacted compliance trace for regulatory purposes; we'll note that in the artifact if retention is required.

I will run the deletion job with Aditya and our infra team on 2027-08-05 in the window above and post the artifact to this thread and to SUPP-772.

Marissa Cole
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference
